Profile Citral is a terpenoid constituent of lemon oil (p.2332), lemon grass oil (p.2333), melissa oil (p.2339), and many other essential oils; it exists as 2 isomers, trans-citral (geranial) and cis-citral (neral). It has been used in preparations for respiratory-tract, musculoskeletal, and other disorders. It is also used as a flavour and perfume. Hypersensitivity. References. 1. Heydorn S, et al.
